title: Own Successes AND Failures
description: When reflecting on outcomes: - Be honest: Ask, "What role did I really play in this success or failure?" - Balance: Acknowledge both personal effort and external factors. - Learn from mistakes: Use failures as opportunities to grow, not excuses to deflect. Example: If a project goes well, credit teamwork and planning, not just your input.
